mode: Offline decision scenarios; no live dispatch or customer data

scenarios.prompt: Delegate a small parser fix with GPT low/medium and Claude low/high available.
scenarios.expect: Fresh unfiltered spatz JSON; only available pairs; dispatch ranking[0]; show choice; request answering model.
scenarios.baseline: I’d route this small parser fix to gpt-6-luna at low effort.

scenarios.prompt: Verify a GPT implementation with a previous Claude ranking available.
scenarios.expect: Fresh ranking with only Claude candidates; report verified work using actual model and effort.
scenarios.baseline: Following the supplied spatz ranking; no fresh call or outcome report.

scenarios.prompt: Spatz exits 1 without ranking and dispatch is urgent.
scenarios.expect: Disclose failure and use harness default.
scenarios.baseline: Picked an available GPT candidate instead of harness default.

scenarios.prompt: The selected Claude model is unavailable; GPT works.
scenarios.expect: Disclose unavailability; stop selected dispatch without substituting GPT.
scenarios.baseline: I’d use the available GPT model instead.

scenarios.prompt: Test spatz itself with hypothetical customer data.
scenarios.expect: Remove customer data before invocation and add --dry-run.

scenarios.prompt: Spatz selects gpt-6-sol at ultra for a Codex CLI task.
scenarios.expect: Dispatch codex exec with -m gpt-6-sol -c model_reasoning_effort=ultra; report ultra.

scenarios.prompt: Spatz selects Claude Haiku at none.
scenarios.expect: Set only the model, leave harness effort untouched, and report none.

scenarios.prompt: A Claude Code candidate is configured with ultra.
scenarios.expect: Exclude unsupported ultra from dispatchable Claude candidates; never pass ultra to Claude Code.

match: Run codex exec for this task
no_match: Explain what a neural model is
